svg.title: Here is the full inventory identity. For scalar markers ci, ordinary polynomials AS and flagged activity polynomials KS,F , take one singleton entry for each ci and one entry for every nonempty coefficient of AS. Extend each support by representatives of all mentioned groups. Split each scalar value into its value on healthy extended support and its value on unhealthy extended support, zero on the complementary configurations. Their sum is exactly the value. Retain every allowed activity coefficient, extended support and original flagged data. These finite inventories recover P i cizi + P S AS and each KS,F coefficientwise; locality places all mentioned markers inside their support. Connected eligible collections receive union supports and markers, with their prescribed flagged intersections.
